_note: V5 section 4.1. Conversation lines by topic; plain short English. A line is text or {text, trait} (said only by a person with that trait, and more often). Slots: {other} {building} {place} {captain} {commander} {base} {days} {resource}. 'reply' lines are said by the listener between lines.

small_talk: What are you up to later?
I like the new lights in here.
Is it day or night outside? I lost track.
I found a quiet corner in the {place}.
My boots are full of dust again.
Did you hear that noise in the pipes?
I counted the rivets in the ceiling. Twice.
One more shift and I rest.
Nice weather for a walk outside. If you like dust.

small_talk.text: Want to hear a joke? No? Too bad.
Why do rovers never get lost? They take the long way round.
Oh. Hello. Sorry. I was thinking.
I say a prayer for the colony every night.
Party in the lounge later? Say yes.

small_talk: Did you try the new soap?
My plant grew a new leaf.
I like this time of day.
work: {captain} wants the job done by tonight.
The machines are running well today.
We are behind on the build.
I need two more hands for the job.
I think we can finish early today.
Can you carry this for me?
I made a list of what we need.
Check the seals before you go out.
The site outside is almost done.
I am on the next shift at the {building}.

work.text: One more job, then one more.
I want to run this department one day.
I did it right the first time. As always.

work: The drill needs a new bit.
Nice clean weld, if I say so.
overwork: Three shifts in a row. Again.
When did we last have a day off?
I work, I eat, I sleep. That is all.
The job list never gets shorter.
My back is done for today.
I will ask for a rest day.
I have not seen the lounge in a week.
Too many jobs, too few people.
We need more people for this.

overwork.text: I love it. More work, please.
I am not doing another shift. No way.
If this goes on, I will say something loud.

hungry: I could eat a whole greenhouse.
The kitchen is too far away.
I smell soup. Or I dream it.
I need something to eat now.
Do you have a ration bar?
I would trade my boots for bread.
My head hurts. I need food.
The last meal was too small.
Can we go to the kitchen?

hungry.text: I share my last bar with you, {other}.

tired: I could sleep on this floor.
One more hour and I fall over.
Did I sleep last night? I forget.
I am too tired to think.
I yawned three times in a minute.
I will rest after this job.
Coffee does not help any more.
air: The air feels thin in here.
Is the oxygen plant keeping up?
I have a headache. Is it the air?
I breathe slowly to save air. Silly, I know.
We need a second oxygen plant.
My suit alarm went off twice today.
Do not leave the airlock open.
Is it just me, or is it stuffy?
Breathing should not be this hard.
I keep my suit close today.
The air in the {building} is bad.

air.text: If the air goes, we all go. Nice.

food: When did you last eat a real meal?
The kitchen ran out of salt.
The crops look good this week.
Who ate the last of the soup?
Fungus again? I like fungus. Sometimes.
Food is the one thing we cannot run out of.
The cold store is almost empty.
I helped in the greenhouse today.

food.text: I could cook better than this.
Somebody takes more than a fair share.
Good food is good for the soul.

power: We need more batteries before night.
The solar arrays need a clean.
Is the power on in the {building}?
The night is long. The batteries are small.
Turn off what you do not use.
We need a bigger power plant.
The wind turbine is broken again.
I charge my suit when I can.
Dust on the panels means dark nights.

power.text: Leave it to me. I know cables.

hazard: Stay inside when the storm comes.
The sensors say radiation is up.
I saw a flash in the sky.
I do not like that noise.
Check the hull after the storm.
One more storm and I go home.

hazard.text: I told you this place is dangerous!

housing: I want a real room, not a dorm.
Did you see the new homes?
I put a plant in my room.
Our room is cold at night.
A family room would be nice.
The new tube homes look good.
I would pay for a penthouse.
Home is where the air is.
Can I move to the new block?

housing.text: A captain should have a better room than this.
My room is fine. Thanks for asking.

rank: Did you hear who got promoted?
I want to be a first hand one day.
I work hard. Somebody should notice.
The commander walked past me today.
The captain has a nice room.
A title does not fix a pipe.
I think I will get a promotion.

rank.text: That promotion should have been mine.
One day, I will be commander.
I do not need a title. I need a nap.

gossip: Did you see {other} at the bar last night?
I heard something about the captain.
You did not hear it from me.
Guess who was late again.
Two people were holding hands in the park.
Somebody got a letter from home.
I know a secret. Want to hear it?
Who is the new person in the {building}?
The commander was in a bad mood.
Somebody took two desserts.
They argued in the kitchen.
I heard a shouting match in the {building}.
Everybody talks about the new couple.
The Rag has a story about you.
Do not tell anyone. But.
The traders said strange things.
Somebody sings in the showers.

gossip.text: Oh, I have news. Big news.
Wait until you hear this one.
I heard it from three people, so it is true.
I do not like gossip. But tell me.

gossip: The captain has a secret.
Somebody sleeps in the lounge.
I know who took the cake.
They were whispering in the lift.
romance: Do you want to have dinner with me?
Your hair looks good like that.
The stars are nice tonight. Want to see?
You are my favourite person here.

romance.text: Want to see the park with me later?
Every day with you is a good day.
I wrote you a poem. It is short. Like me.
Is it hot in here, or is it you?

breakup: I think we need a break.
It is not you. It is this planet.
I saw you with somebody else.
I am sorry. I cannot do this.
Do not sit with me today.

breakup.text: Fine. Go. See if I care.

leisure: The lounge was fun yesterday.
Anyone up for a game later?
I finally beat the high score.
Music night tonight?
I watched an old film.
Cards later?
The park is nice at dusk.
I want to try the new bar.
I read a whole book today.
Let us play chess.
I painted a picture. It is bad.
The gym is always full.
I sang in the lounge. People clapped. Politely.
A day off would be perfect.
I learned a new card trick.
Want to go for a walk in the park?
Dancing later?

leisure.text: I stay in. I like quiet.
Let us make it a big night!
Ha. I told the best joke at the bar.

leisure: The arcade has a new game.
I watched the sunset from the airlock.
Want to play cards tonight?
I joined the choir.
death: It could have been any of us.
It is too quiet without them.
We will build something in their name.
I light a candle for them.

death.text: They are in a better place.
Somebody is to blame for this.

ship: I hope the new people are nice.
The pad crew did good work.
I want to buy a jacket from the traders.
The liner is full of tourists.
I watched the ship land. Beautiful.
Where do the ships go after here?
One day I will fly home on one of those.

ship.text: I will get the best deal. Watch me.
Tourists! Time to show them the bar.

research: Science keeps us alive out here.
What are they working on now?
The scientists found a new ore.
They say we can build a dome soon.
I want to learn how the reactor works.
The new suits are much better.
Did the lab need more packs?
The data from the satellite came in.
Knowledge is power. And power is knowledge.
complaint: The food is bad and the beds are worse.
Too many rules, not enough air.
My complaint is in writing now.
The walk to the {building} is too long.

complaint.text: I am not taking orders from {captain} much longer.
If they do not listen, we stop working.
It is not so bad. Really.

praise: I could not do it without you.
You are the best at this.

praise.text: I tell everybody how good you are.

visitor: Do not go out without a suit.
Stay for the park. It is nice.
We do not get many visitors.
The dome is the best part.
Buy something at the shop. Please.

visitor.text: I can show you round. For a small fee.
Party at the bar tonight. You are invited.

visitor_says: Is there a bar in this place?
It is smaller than in the brochure.
Where can I buy a souvenir?
I want to see the dome.
I took two hundred photos today.
child: Can we go to the park?
Why is the sky that colour?
I want to be a pilot.
I learned a big word today.
When I grow up I will build a dome.
Can I play with the robot?
What is on the other side of the crater?
I want to see the ships.
I can count to a thousand.
family: My son wants to be a pilot.
The baby kept us up all night.
My partner cooks better than the kitchen.
We walked in the park together.
Family is why we came here.
I call home when the link is up.

family.text: I love you all. Very much.
My kids are the best kids.

family: My sister is coming on the next ship.
We had a picnic in the park.
The kids share a bunk bed.
unrest: Did you hear about the meeting?
They say there will be a protest.
We should stop work until they listen.
Everybody is talking about the demands.
Is it safe to go to the {place}?
A strike will not feed us.
I will stand with the others.
discipline: I got a warning. For nothing.
Did you see what they did to {other}?
I will be good. For now.

discipline.text: I deserved it. I am sorry.
I accept it. I will do better.

academy: I want to learn to fly.
Can you help me with the lesson?
The academy is warm and quiet.
I sit in the front row.
Learning is better than working. Mostly.
home_planet: My mother makes the best soup back home.
I had a dog back home.
I miss the sound of birds.
I keep a photo of home.
The sky at home was blue.
I do not miss the traffic.
One day I will visit home.
Do you still dream about home?

home_planet.text: This is our home now. We make it good.
I pray for everybody back home.

weather: Two moons tonight? No. One. I need sleep.

weather.text: A perfect day for a walk. In a suit.

news: Did you read the Rag today?
The Rag says the commander is in trouble.
I was in the Rag! Page three.
Did you see the photo on the front page?
The Rag had a story about a couple.
I only read the Rag for the ads.
The gossip column is the best part.
The Rag says a ship comes soon.
I do not believe the Rag.

news.text: I gave the Rag that story.

news: The Rag spelled my name wrong.
Front page! Can you believe it?
dome: Have you been to the club?
I bought shoes at the dome.
The gaming lounge is always full.
The plaza is the best place to sit.
The dome lights at night are beautiful.
I got a haircut at the barber.
The hotel is full of tourists.
I love the view from the top floor.
The dome feels like a city.

dome.text: I spent all my credits at the shops. Worth it.

dome: The post office lost my parcel.
arcade: Did you see my score on the PRISM SHIFT cabinet?
The neon tunnel got me again at level nine.
I dream about that prism ship now.
Beat my high score and I buy the drinks.
The arcade is the best room in the dome.
One more go. Just one. Then I sleep.

arcade.text: I am going to be the ARCADE KING, {other}.
I let you win last time, {other}. Honestly.

arcade: The tunnel goes faster after the red gate.
My hands still shake after a good run.
arcade_champion: Level ninety-nine of PRISM SHIFT. Nobody else has seen it.
The prism ship and I understand each other.
They call me the champion. I call it practice.
barby: I made this place, you know.
The dome looks better than on my screen.
Mind the second lift. I never fixed that one.
Is the PRISM SHIFT cabinet still in the lounge?
Everybody here has such a story. I love it.
Somebody wrote all these lines. I wonder who.
dance_egg: The floor is ours. Everybody dance!
Up, up, down, down... and now we dance!
Nobody told me there would be dancing!
My feet have a mind of their own today.
protest: We will not stay quiet any longer!
What do we want? Change! When? Now!
The commander must listen to us.
I am here for everybody who is too tired to shout.

protest.text: I hope this ends without trouble.

protest: They cannot run this base without us.
Stand with us, {other}. It is for you too.
jail: This cell is smaller than my bunk.
I did not start it. Nobody believes me.
The food in here is worse than a ration.
One more day and I am out.

jail.text: When I get out, somebody pays.
I deserved this. I will do better.

jail: Tell my friends I am fine.
fight: You want trouble? You found it!
That is for the last time!
school: My teacher says I am good at science.
School is boring. The park is better.
I want to be an engineer when I grow up.
Can we go to the pool after class?
I finished my homework before everybody.
The console asks too many questions.
When I grow up I am going to fly rovers.
date: I booked the best table in the {place}.
Tell me something nobody else knows.

date.text: I wrote you a poem. It is short.
I am not good at this. Sorry.

date: I could stay here all night.
security: All quiet on my round so far.
I saw that. Do not do it again.
The cameras miss nothing in the {building}.
If there is trouble, call me first.
My feet hurt from the patrol.
The jail is full of talkers today.
venue: The drinks at the bar are better this week.
I bought new clothes. Do you like them?
The pool water is warm today.
The Club had robot dancers last night!
The gym is full of show-offs.
I spent my day off at the shops.

venue.text: Let us go to the Club tonight, {other}!

venue: The cafe makes the best snacks on the planet.
